items.followUp: Differentiate between static friction and sliding friction.

rubric.how: Award for stating that sliding friction acts when one surface slides over another.

rubric.why: Identifies rolling friction and compares its magnitude with sliding friction.
rubric.description: Defines rolling friction and states the comparison.
rubric.how: Award for stating that rolling friction acts when an object rolls over a surface and is less than sliding friction.

modelAnswer: Sliding friction acts when one surface slides over another and opposes their relative motion.
Rolling friction acts when an object rolls over a surface; it is less than sliding friction.
